testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect file type choices when saving a part: tmp/obk-save-inspect-pinned-20261115/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:78:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect file type choices when saving a part ✔ Given the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user opens the file type list ✔ Then the list offers the native part file type and an All Files filter

testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect save-change prompt frequency choices: tmp/obk-save-inspect-pinned-20261115/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:102:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect save-change prompt frequency choices ✔ Given an unsaved modified part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ When the user closes the document tab ✔ And the user opens the prompt-frequency list ✔ Then the list offers always show, once per operation, suppress for this session and suppress permanently ✔ When the user dismisses the list without changing its selection ✔ And the user cancels the save-changes prompt ✔ Then the part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect Save As commands for a saved part: tmp/obk-save-inspect-pinned-20261115/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:246:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect Save As commands for a saved part ✔ Given a saved part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user opens the application menu ✔ And the user expands Save As ✔ Then the menu offers Save As and Save Copy As ✔ And it offers Save Copy As Template and Pack and Go ✔ And the Save Copy As description says the original file remains open

testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the first-save preview of a solid part: tmp/obk-save-inspect-pinned-20261115/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:258:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the first-save preview of a solid part ✔ Given an unsaved part containing a visible rectangular solid is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the first-save preview settings are configured to save an isometric component view ✔ When the user presses Control+S ✔ Then the Save As dialog opens with a proposed part filename selected ✔ And Save Preview Picture is checked ✔ And Active Component Iso View on Save is selected ✔ And the preview area displays a shaded isometric block
